profile.headline: Lead DevOps / Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
At Liberty Energy, my focus is on leveraging my AWS certification and proficiency in Azure DevOps Services and Amazon ECS to develop robust solutions that drive efficiency. My role as a Software Engineer is enriched by my hands-on experience with cloud platforms and a strong background in data integrity from my previous position at IHS Markit.

The organization benefits from my proven track record in creating PowerBI reports, managing SQL servers, and implementing C# software for project data validation. With a knack for troubleshooting and a commitment to continuous learning, I aim to contribute to transformative projects that align with our mission of innovation and excellence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Docker · DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Methodologies · Azure DevOps · Software Design Patterns · Amazon S3 · AWS CloudFormation · Problem Solving · Git · Amazon VPC · Amazon EC2 · AWS ECR · Amazon ECS · REST APIs · Microservices · ASP.NET Core

positions.title: Geophysical Software Sr. Engineer/Analyst
positions.description:
Provided software engineering and technology support for Kingdom, SQL server and related applications. Analyzed and recommended software functionalities and enhancements to Product Management teams. 

•	Designed and created PowerBI reports using SQL server as backend.
•	Created Knowledge base articles for end users and Tier 2 customer support.
•	Generated customized SQL scripts for Kingdom software troubleshooting.
•	Installed and maintained multiple SQL servers for troubleshooting and testing.
•	Implemented software to validate Kingdom project data and schema integrity using C# and SQL.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · C# · Problem Solving · SQL Server Management Studio · SQL

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
•	Analyzed, designed, and developed Python application with GUI for prototype Heart beats device.
•	Used Google Cloud, TensorFlow, Keras, Pandas, Visual Code and Docker.
•	Designed and implemented R & D Machine learning models for training.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Agile Methodologies · Python (Programming Language) · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Problem Solving · Git · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Analysis, design and implementation of custom Petrel Plugins using  C# , WPF and Matlab.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Software Design Patterns · WPF · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Windows Software Development · Problem Solving · WinForms · Object Oriented Design · OOP

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Administered enhancement, maintenance and support for the end users of internal Petrel plugin Single Well Predictive Model (SWPM).

•	Acted as primary SME (Subject Matter Expert) for SWPM within PTS (Petro Technical Services).
•	Successfully upgraded, improved and maintained code base of SWPM with different versions of Petrel, Visual Studio and Schlumberger simulators like ECLIPSE and GREAT.
•	Analyzed, documented, prioritized and implemented SWPM requirements on TFS with Scrum iterations.
•	Consolidated and restructured folders and code that made it transparent with reduced complexity making it easy to understand and maintain.
•	Optimized and improved continuous integration build process with TFS that made the build 20% faster and increased developer productivity.
•	Attained 50% increase in the Unit Test coverage of SWPM with newly designed, authored and executed unit tests.
•	Automated Petrel’s Intersection window creation from SWPM that increased the end user productivity.

positions.title: Consulting Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities included enhancements, maintenance and support for end users of Schlumberger’s internal Petrel plugins Single Well Predictive Model (SWPM) and Enhanced Oil Recovery Tool (EORt).

•	Analyzed and assessed requirements using Ocean, Petrel and Internal Petrel API to create development plans for EOR-IO.
•	Engineered new features Uncertainty Analysis, Aquifer and VFP table support for SWPM on schedule that was well received by the field users.
•	Designed, implemented and tested custom charts using Nevron charts that are not available through Ocean API for Petrel.
•	Revived and upgraded a non-functional internal application BRIGHT to work on latest .NET framework.

positions.title: Ocean Petrel Developer
positions.description:
Implemented custom Ocean Petrel plug-in development, setting up web-services and code reviews. 

•	Integrated R&D software with Ocean Petrel as a plug-in.
•	Engineered, mediated and programmed R&D software code for multithreaded approach using CUDA.
•	Mentored and provided detailed explanation of Ocean for Petrel API and its limitations to other team members.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Software Design Patterns · Windows Software Development · Problem Solving · WinForms · Object Oriented Design · OOP

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for technical expert analysis of software tools for toolkit deployment, development and performance. 

•	Provided technical expert analysis for obfuscation, continuous integration, unit test and profiling.
•	Designed, developed and deployed a web demo using ASP.NET with C# based web service.
•	Strengthened INT Geotoolkit.NET API performance with code review and optimization.
•	Researched and critiqued multi-threaded approach for Geotoolkit.NET.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Software Design Patterns · Windows Software Development · Problem Solving · WinForms · Object Oriented Design · OOP

positions.title: Consulting Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Played a vital role in strategic Petrel improvement project involving 2D graphics by redesign and implementation of the Well Section window in Petrel using INT Toolkit and Ocean in C# for ease of extensibility. Enabled continuous performance improvement in rendering and data retrieval in terms of speed and data size (200gb+) and achieved performance gain by 30 %. 

•	Designed and implemented highly optimized and complex data structures, business logic, ergonomical user interface and efficient backend to meet the extreme performance requirement of Petrel.
•	Designed and developed custom visuals using Geosciences toolkit to fulfill project requirements.
•	Coordinated with domain experts on functional requirements, identify project limitation and capability.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Software Design Patterns · Windows Software Development · Problem Solving · WinForms · Object Oriented Design · OOP

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked in a team to develop win form based 3-tier application for underwriting.

Analyzed user requirements.

Designed and developed UI, designed and developed SQL Database for the application.

Developed code for database access, modifications, and constructions including stored procedures.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Software Design Patterns · Windows Software Development · WinForms · Object Oriented Design · SQL Server Management Studio · SQL · OOP
